name: lk-mcp
description: Read and edit a LegendKeeper world wiki: pages, maps, timelines, calendars, templates and boards, with a spoiler guard for DM-only content.
long_description: lk-mcp lets Claude create, read, update and delete content in one LegendKeeper project through the LegendKeeper API. Every write supports a dry run, and versioned writes never overwrite a change made in the app since Claude's last read. The optional spoiler guard refuses any write that would show a protected term (one per line in a text file you keep outside the wiki) on content players can see; secret blocks, hidden pages and hidden documents may hold them.

api_key.title: LegendKeeper API key
api_key.description: An API key for the one project Claude should work in (LegendKeeper > Project settings > API). Try a sandbox project's key first.

guard_file.title: Spoiler terms file
guard_file.description: A text file with one protected term per line, kept outside the wiki. A write that would show one of them to players is refused. Without it (and with the guard on), Claude can read but not write.

spoiler_guard.title: Spoiler guard
spoiler_guard.description: Check every write against the spoiler terms file. Turn off only for a project players never see.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Offer Claude only the read tools.
